causal_basis: The pinned action-video latent builder deletes its explicit height and width arguments, then uses integer floor division of the preprocessed video tensor dimensions by the spatial VAE factor. For a 540-pixel input height, 540 // 16 is 33 and the decoded output is 528 pixels high.
claim_boundary: This diagnosis explains the deterministic 540-to-528 structural mismatch. It does not explain or excuse the independent static-video failure and does not convert the failed canary into a pass.
